result.summary: the unchanged pipeline returns the same 160 rows as MongoDB: 36.8 s here (1 run) against 4.8 s on MongoDB (median of 3 runs), 7.6x slower. The API translates the pipeline stage by stage, so each $lookup becomes a lookup per document and the optimizer never sees the whole question. $sql hands it the whole question

left.sql:
with 
"Q1" ("ID", "DATA") as (select "RESID", "DATA" from "MIG"."orders"), 
"Q2" ("DATA") as (
  select "DATA"
  from "Q1" q
  where JSON_EXISTS("DATA",'$?( exists(@.placedAt?( (@.dateTimeOnly() >= $B0) && (@.dateTimeOnly() < $B1) )) )' passing ? as "B0", ? as "B1" type(strict))
), 
"Q3" ("ID", "DATA") as (select "RESID", "DATA" from "MIG"."subscribers"), 
"Q4" ("DATA", "SOURCE") as (
  select json_transform(r."DATA",
    assign '$."sub"' = json [
      select f."DATA"
      from "Q3" f 
      where 
        json_exists(f."DATA", '$?(@."_id" == $x)' passing
          json_query(r."DATA", '$."subscriber"."id"' error on error disallow array) as "x" type(strict)
        )
    ]
    type(strict)
  ),r."DATA"
  from "Q2" r
), 
"Q5" ("DATA") as (
  select jt."DATA"
  from "Q4" q, json_expand_array(q."DATA", '$."sub"[*]' columns("DATA" json path '$')) jt
), 
"Q6" ("ID", "DATA") as (select "RESID", "DATA" from "MIG"."accounts"), 
"Q7" ("DATA", "SOURCE") as (
  select json_transform(r."DATA",
    assign '$."acct"' = json [
      select f."DATA"
      from "Q6" f 
      where 
        json_exists(f."DATA", '$?(@."_id" == $x)' passing
          json_query(r."DATA", '$."sub"."accountId"' error on error disallow array) as "x" type(strict)
        )
    ]
    type(strict)
  ),r."DATA"
  from "Q5" r
), 
"Q8" ("DATA") as (
  select jt."DATA"
  from "Q7" q, json_expand_array(q."DATA", '$."acct"[*]' columns("DATA" json path '$')) jt
), 
"Q9" ("DATA") as (
  select jt."DATA"
  from "Q8" q, json_expand_array(q."DATA", '$."lines"[*]' columns("DATA" json path '$')) jt
), 
"Q10" ("ID", "DATA") as (select "RESID", "DATA" from "MIG"."catalog"), 
"Q11" ("DATA", "SOURCE") as (
  select json_transform(r."DATA",
    assign '$."item"' = json [
      select f."DATA"
      from "Q10" f 
      where 
        json_exists(f."DATA", '$?(@."_id" == $x)' passing
          json_query(r."DATA", '$."lines"."sku"' error on error disallow array) as "x" type(strict)
        )
    ]
    type(strict)
  ),r."DATA"
  from "Q9" r
), 
"Q12" ("DATA") as (
  select jt."DATA"
  from "Q11" q, json_expand_array(q."DATA", '$."item"[*]' columns("DATA" json path '$')) jt
), 
"Q13" ("DATA") as (
  select json_transform(
    "DATA",
    set '$tmp2' = PATH '$."item"."kind".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmp1' = PATH '$tmp2.domCompare() == $b1',
    case when '@?(toBoolean($tmp1, "lax") == true)'
    then (set '$tmp' = PATH '$b2')
    else (set '$tmp' = PATH '$b3') end,
    set '$tmpP0' = PATH '$tmp' ignore on empty,
    assign '$."isPlan"' = PATH '$tmpP0' ignore on empty
    passing json_scalar('plan') as "b1",
      json_scalar(1 as int) as "b2",
      json_scalar(0 as int) as "b3"
  )
  from "Q12" q
), 
"Q14" ("KEY0", "KEY1", "KEY2", "ACC0", "ACC1", "ACC2", "T1", "T2", "T3") as (
  select
    json_query("DATA", '$."acct"."region"' with conditional array wrapper error on error json null on empty)
     as "KEY0",json_query("DATA", '$."acct"."tier"' with conditional array wrapper error on error json null on empty)
     as "KEY1",json_query("DATA", '$."sub"."_id"' with conditional array wrapper error on error json null on empty)
     as "KEY2", 
    json_query("DATA", '$."sub"."name"' with conditional array wrapper error on error null on empty) as ACC0, 
    json_transform(
      "DATA",
      set '$tmp1' = PATH '$."lines"."qty".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
      set '$tmp2' = PATH '$."lines"."price".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
      set '$tmp' = PATH '$tmp1 * $tmp2',
    assign '$' = PATH '$tmp'
    ) as ACC1, 
    json_transform(
      "DATA",
      set '$tmp2' = PATH '$."isPlan".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
      set '$tmp1' = PATH '$tmp2.domCompare() == $b1',
      case when '@?(toBoolean($tmp1, "lax") == true)'
      then (set '$tmp' = PATH '$."item"."name".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty)
      else (set '$tmp' = PATH '$b2') end,
    assign '$' = PATH '$tmp'
      passing json_scalar(1 as int) as "b1",
        treat(? as json(scalar null)) as "b2"
    ) as ACC2,
    json_value(
      json_query("DATA", '$."isPlan"' with conditional array wrapper error on error json null on empty),
      '$' returning any ora_rawcompare
    ) T1,
    json_value(
      json_query("DATA", '$."placedAt"' with conditional array wrapper error on error json null on empty),
      '$' returning any ora_rawcompare
    ) T2,
    json_value(
      json_query("DATA", '$."_id"' with conditional array wrapper error on error json null on empty),
      '$' returning any ora_rawcompare
    ) T3
  from "Q13" q
),
"Q15" ("KEY0", "KEY1", "KEY2", "ACC0", "ACC1", "TYPS1", "ACC2", "T1", "T2", "T3") as (
  select 
    
    "KEY0", 
    "KEY1", 
    "KEY2", 
    "ACC0", 
    "ACC1", 
    case 
      when json_exists("ACC1", '$?(@.type2() == "int")') then 1
      when json_exists("ACC1", '$?(@.type2() == "long")') then 2
      when json_exists("ACC1", '$?(@.type2() in ("float","number","double"))') then 4
      when json_exists("ACC1", '$?(@.type2() == "decimal")') then 3
      else 0
    end, 
    "ACC2", 
    "T1", 
    "T2", 
    "T3"
  from "Q14" q
),
"Q16" ("KEY0", "KEY1", "KEY2", "ACC0", "ACC1", "TYPS1", "ACC2") as (
  select "KEY0", "KEY1", "KEY2", 
    (any_value("ACC0")), 
    sum(json_value("ACC1" , '$.numberOnly()'  default 0 on error)), 
    max("TYPS1"), 
    (
        min("ACC2") keep (dense_rank first order by T1 desc, T2 desc, T3 desc)
    )
  from "Q15" q group by "KEY0", "KEY1", "KEY2"
), 
"Q17" ("DATA") as (
  select json {
    '_id' : {'region' value "KEY0", 'tier' value "KEY1", 'subscriberId' value "KEY2"}, 
    ? value "ACC0", 
    ? value case
      when "ACC1" is NULL then
        json_scalar(0 as int)
      when "TYPS1" <= 1 and "ACC1" <= 2147483647 then
        json_scalar("ACC1" as int)
      when "TYPS1" <= 2 and "ACC1" <= 9223372036854775807 then
        json_scalar("ACC1" as long)
      when "TYPS1" <= 3 then
        json_scalar("ACC1" as decimal)
      else
        json_scalar(to_binary_double("ACC1"))
      end, 
    ? value "ACC2"
  }
  from "Q16" q
  
), 
"Q18" ("KEY0", "KEY1", "ACC0", "NKEY", "T1", "T2") as (
  select
    json_query("DATA", '$."_id"."region"' with conditional array wrapper error on error json null on empty)
     as "KEY0",json_query("DATA", '$."_id"."tier"' with conditional array wrapper error on error json null on empty)
     as "KEY1", 
    json_transform(
      "DATA",
      set '$tmp1' = PATH '$."_id"."subscriberId".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
      set '$tmp2' = PATH '$."name".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
      set '$tmp3' = PATH '$."plan".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
      set '$tmp4' = PATH '$."spend".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
      set '$tmp' = PATH 'newObject("subscriberId", $tmp1,"name", $tmp2,"plan", $tmp3,"spend", $tmp4)' ignore on empty,
    assign '$' = PATH '$tmp'
    ) as ACC0, 
    json_transform(
      "DATA",
      set '$tmp1' = PATH '$."_id"."region".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
      set '$tmp2' = PATH '$."_id"."tier".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
      set '$tmp' = PATH 'newObject("region", $tmp1,"tier", $tmp2)' ignore on empty,
    assign '$' = PATH '$tmp'
    ) as NKEY,
    json_value(
      json_query("DATA", '$."spend"' with conditional array wrapper error on error json null on empty),
      '$' returning any ora_rawcompare
    ) T1,
    json_value(
      json_query("DATA", '$."_id"."subscriberId"' with conditional array wrapper error on error json null on empty),
      '$' returning any ora_rawcompare
    ) T2
  from "Q17" q
),
"Q19" ("KEY0", "KEY1", "ACC0", "RNTB0", "NTB0", "T1", "T2") as (
  select 
    
    "KEY0", 
    "KEY1", 
    "ACC0", 
    row_number() over (partition by KEY0, KEY1 order by T1 desc, T2 asc), 
    any_value(
      treat(
        json_scalar(5 as int) as json(scalar number))) over (partition by KEY0, KEY1), 
    "T1", 
    "T2"
  from "Q18" q
),
"Q20" ("KEY0", "KEY1", "ACC0") as (
  select "KEY0", "KEY1", 
    json_arrayagg(case when "NTB0" <= 0 or mod(json_value("NTB0" , '$' returning number), 1) <> 0 then json_transform(json('{}'), check '"1" in ("2")' else 'Error: N must be an int greater than 0') when "RNTB0" <= "NTB0" then coalesce("ACC0", json('null')) end order by "RNTB0" asc returning json)
  from "Q19" q group by "KEY0", "KEY1"
), 
"Q21" ("DATA") as (
  select json {
    '_id' : {'region' value "KEY0", 'tier' value "KEY1"}, 
    ? value "ACC0"
  }
  from "Q20" q
  
), 
"Q22" ("DATA", "POSITION") as (
  select jt."DATA", jt.position-1
  from "Q21" q, json_expand_array(q."DATA", '$."top"[*]' columns("DATA" json path '$', position for ordinality)) jt
), 
"Q23" ("DATA") as (
  select json_transform("DATA", set '$.i' = "POSITION")
  from "Q22" q
), 
"Q24" ("DATA") as (
  select json_transform(
    "DATA",
    set '$tmp' = PATH '$."_id"."region".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmpP0' = PATH '$tmp' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmp' = PATH '$."_id"."tier".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmpP1' = PATH '$tmp' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmp1' = PATH '$."i".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmp' = PATH '$tmp1 + $b1',
    set '$tmpP2' = PATH '$tmp' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmp' = PATH '$."top"."subscriberId".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmpP3' = PATH '$tmp' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmp' = PATH '$."top"."name".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmpP4' = PATH '$tmp' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmp' = PATH '$."top"."plan".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmpP5' = PATH '$tmp' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmp' = PATH '$."top"."spend".arrayagg("wrap")' ignore on empty,
    set '$tmpP6' = PATH '$tmp' ignore on empty,
    assign '$."region"' = PATH '$tmpP0' ignore on empty,
    assign '$."tier"' = PATH '$tmpP1' ignore on empty,
    assign '$."rank"' = PATH '$tmpP2' ignore on empty,
    assign '$."subscriberId"' = PATH '$tmpP3' ignore on empty,
    assign '$."name"' = PATH '$tmpP4' ignore on empty,
    assign '$."plan"' = PATH '$tmpP5' ignore on empty,
    assign '$."spend"' = PATH '$tmpP6' ignore on empty,
    keep 
      '$."region"',
      '$."tier"',
      '$."rank"',
      '$."subscriberId"',
      '$."name"',
      '$."plan"',
      '$."spend"', remove '$."_id"'
    passing json_scalar(1 as int) as "b1"
  )
  from "Q23" q
), 
"Q25" ("DATA") as (
  select "DATA"
  from "Q24" q
  order by JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.region[*].min()') asc nulls first, JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.tier[*].min()') asc nulls first, JSON_QUERY("DATA", '$.rank[*].min()') asc nulls first
)
select "DATA" from "Q25"

right.sql:
with lines as (
  select json_value(o.data, '$.subscriber.id' returning varchar2(10) error on error) subscriber_id,
         json_value(o.data, '$._id' returning varchar2(24) error on error) order_id,
         o.data.placedAt.timestamp()                                    placed_at,
         l.sku, l.qty, l.price
    from "orders" o,
         json_table(o.data, '$.lines[*]' columns (
           sku   varchar2(20) path '$.sku',
           qty   number       path '$.qty',
           price number       path '$.price')) l
   where o.data.placedAt.timestamp() >= :fromTs
     and o.data.placedAt.timestamp() <  :toTs
),
spend as (
  select l.subscriber_id,
         sum(l.qty * l.price) spend,
         max(case when c.data.kind.string() = 'plan'
                  then json_value(c.data, '$.name' returning varchar2(60) error on error) end)
           keep (dense_rank last order by case when c.data.kind.string() = 'plan' then 1 else 0 end,
                                          l.placed_at, l.order_id) plan
    from lines l
    join "catalog" c on c.data."_id".string() = l.sku
   group by l.subscriber_id
),
ranked as (
  select a.data.region.string() region,
         a.data.tier.string()   tier,
         sp.subscriber_id,
         s.data.name.string()   name,
         sp.plan,
         sp.spend,
         rank() over (partition by a.data.region.string(), a.data.tier.string()
                      order by sp.spend desc, sp.subscriber_id) rnk
    from spend sp
    join "subscribers" s on s.data."_id".string() = sp.subscriber_id
    join "accounts"    a on a.data."_id".string() = s.data.accountId.string()
)
select json {'region' : region, 'tier' : tier, 'rank' : rnk, 'subscriberId' : subscriber_id,
             'name' : name, 'plan' : plan, 'spend' : json_scalar(spend as decimal)}
  from ranked
 where rnk <= 5
 order by region, tier, rnk
